top_news.title: NanoGPT Speedrun Frontier
top_news.dek: PRIME Intellect conducted 153 autonomous training runs across 18 frontier models to benchmark and optimize nanoGPT performance.
top_news.brief: The research team executed a series of autonomous training runs to analyze the nanoGPT optimizer. The study focuses on identifying performance bottlenecks and efficiency gains in training frontier-scale models.

top_news.title: llm 0.33
top_news.dek: The llm CLI tool version 0.33 upgrades to the OpenAI Python library 3.x and adds per-call API key support for embedding operations.
top_news.brief: This release migrates the HTTP client dependency to httpx2 and updates the underlying OpenAI library. Additionally, the embed and embed-multi commands now support the --key flag, allowing users to pass API keys directly to plugins without modifying global state.
top_news.image_alt: Terminal interface showing llm CLI output

top_news.title: AI is becoming AI's biggest customer as agentic token usage jumps 14x on OpenRouter
top_news.dek: AI agents have surpassed human users in token consumption on OpenRouter, marking a 14x growth in agentic activity since February 2026.
top_news.brief: Data from OpenRouter indicates that AI agents now consume more tokens than human users, with agentic usage growing 14x compared to 2.8x for humans. While raw token counts are surging, nearly 70% of this consumption is attributed to cached prompts, meaning actual compute costs are scaling significantly slower than the volume of requests suggests.
top_news.image_alt: Chart showing the divergence between human and AI agent token consumption on OpenRouter

top_news.title: Meet FreeToken: An Edge-Native MoE Serving Engine that Runs 753B GLM-5.2 on a Single Workstation GPU
top_news.dek: FreeToken is a new edge-native serving engine designed to run massive MoE models like GLM-5.2 on single workstation GPUs.
top_news.brief: FreeToken addresses the hardware gap for frontier open-weight models by optimizing MoE cache management. It dynamically splits cache misses between PCIe transfers and CPU execution based on real-time bandwidth measurements, allowing developers to run large-scale models locally without requiring datacenter-class GPU clusters.
top_news.image_alt: Diagram illustrating FreeToken's architecture for splitting MoE cache misses between GPU and CPU
